jobs.desc: Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building. Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager Job Type: Contract - USA Job Description About This Role Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top. This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below). Role Responsibilities As the SEO AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice. You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems. Monitor evolving search engine algorithms and AI search trends, proactively adjusting strategy to maintain competitive advantage. Establish processes for measuring AI search visibility and zero-click performance impact. Technical Content SEO Execution Perform and present comprehensive technical, content, competitive, local, and app SEO audits. Develop SEO functional specifications for technical enhancements, partnering with developers to implement, QA, and UAT updates. Conduct advanced keyword, topic cluster, and entity research to inform scalable content strategies. Identify opportunities for content optimization, consolidation, pruning, and authority building. Cross-Functional Client Collaboration Collaborate closely with paid search, analytics, UX, product, and development teams to drive integrated search performance. Present insights and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, translating complex SEO and AI-search concepts into business-focused outcomes. Align search strategies with broader omnichannel marketing and digital transformation initiatives. Data, Measurement Automation Take a data-driven approach to measuring SEO and AEO ROI against the metrics defined in Success Metrics below. Develop reporting frameworks that account for traditional traffic, zero-click engagement, SERP feature ownership, and AI search visibility. jobs.title: QA Engineer (EN)
jobs.desc: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release; Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing; Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features. What you bring A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer; Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans; Experience with test automation and test frameworks; You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests; Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira. You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not; You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business. Nice to have Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code; You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support. Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests; You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better; Experience testing mobile apps. We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it , Say it , Make it . What we offer A gross salary between €3,400 and €4,800 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, bi-weekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months and much more; Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: QA Engineer (NL)
jobs.desc: Over de rol Bij YoungOnes zorg jij ervoor dat ons platform doet wat het belooft: stabiel, betrouwbaar en zonder verrassingen voor de mensen die het elke dag gebruiken. Als QA Engineer werk je niet aan het eind van de keten, maar middenin onze ontwikkelteams. Je denkt mee vóórdat er code geschreven wordt, test slim waar het telt en bent de brug tussen development, product en de rest van het bedrijf als het om kwaliteit gaat. Je valt onder de Teamlead Frontend en werkt dagelijks samen met de frontend-, mobile- en backendteams. Wat ga je doen Meedenken vanaf het begin. Je schuift aan bij refinements en helpt teams de risico's en impact van een feature te zien voordat ze gaan bouwen; De juiste testaanpak kiezen. Samen met het team bepaal je per feature wat je automatisch test, wat je handmatig test en waarom; Geautomatiseerde tests bouwen en onderhouden. Je zet tests op voor belangrijke functies van het platform en houdt ze betrouwbaar; Handmatig en verkennend testen. Je gaat zelf door de app heen, zoekt naar randgevallen en vindt wat een script mist; Centraal aanspreekpunt voor bugs. Bugmeldingen uit het hele bedrijf komen bij jou binnen. Je reproduceert ze, verzamelt alle informatie die een developer nodig heeft om ermee aan de slag te gaan en zet ze met de juiste prioriteit klaar in Jira; Adviseren over releases. Je brengt risico's in kaart en geeft een duidelijk advies over de kwaliteit van een release. Inzicht geven. Je verzamelt testdata en laat zien hoe het met de kwaliteit van onze software gaat. Balans bewaken. Je helpt teams de afweging te maken tussen bugs oplossen en nieuwe features bouwen. Wat breng je mee Een hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in informatica, software engineering of iets vergelijkbaars. Minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring, waarvan minimaal 1 jaar als QA Engineer, Software Tester of Test Automation Engineer. Ervaring met het opzetten en uitvoeren van een testaanpak en testplannen. Ervaring met testautomatisering en testframeworks. Je werkt vlot met AI-tools en zet ze gericht in: om sneller en beter te testen en om geautomatiseerde tests op te zetten. Ervaring met werken in een Agile/Scrum-team en met een bugtrackingsysteem, bij voorkeur Jira. Je werkt zelfstandig, durft knopen door te hakken in je eigen werk en geeft gevraagd en ongevraagd advies. Je bent kritisch en analytisch, neemt zelf initiatief en kunt goed schakelen met developers, product en business. Pluspunten Je hebt kennis van TypeScript/JavaScript en kunt zelf goed uit de voeten met code. Je kijkt verder dan "werkt het?": ook naar toegankelijkheid, snelheid, veiligheid en meertaligheid. Je hebt ervaring met tests die automatisch meedraaien bij elke codewijziging, en weet hoe je onbetrouwbare tests aanpakt. Je deelt graag kennis en helpt collega's beter te testen. Je hebt ervaring met het testen van mobiele apps. Wat we van je verwachten We zoeken iemand die kwaliteit ziet als iets van het hele team. Je perfectioneert niet alleen je eigen testwerk, maar vraagt je af wat er structureel moet veranderen zodat het hele team beter test.
